title: service-settings: the storage, knowledge and AI manifests carry their ⚠ warnings inside description and help strings; move each into an `info_banner` row (`bannerSeverity: warning`), item 2 of objectui#12610
body:
Filing gate ③: the objectstack half of objectstack-ai/objectui#12610 item 2 (filed by the epic PM from the 2026-10-16 Setup review, under the maintainer's 「全部立卡」). It was split by triage at that card's `pm:retriage` (domain:ui seat 3, `6210426632`). Splitting "⚠" out of a server string in the console would be the consumer-side tolerance objectui AGENTS.md #0.1 refuses. ⛔ Not a claim.

**Reader who acts:** the `domain:services` seat (`packages/services/service-settings`).

## What the admin reads (the walk on objectui `8415d9f11`)

- **File Storage's subtitle:** "… ⚠ Switching adapter does not migrate existing files — files uploaded under the previous adapter become unreachable through the new one."
- **Knowledge's subtitle:** "⚠ Switching adapter does NOT migrate existing indices."
- **AI & Embedder's "Log full prompts" help text:** "⚠ May leak PII".

They are produced in `service-settings`' `storage.manifest.ts`, `knowledge.manifest.ts` and `ai.manifest.ts`, and in `src/translations/en.ts`, as seat 3 located.

## The structured home already exists

`packages/spec/src/system/settings-manifest.zod.ts` declares the `info_banner` specifier: `bannerText` (a markdown body) and `bannerSeverity: 'info' | 'success' | 'warning' | 'error'`. No spec change is needed.

## The change

- Each ⚠ sentence leaves its `description` / help string and becomes an `info_banner` row with `bannerSeverity: 'warning'`, placed in the section it concerns.
- The translations move with it, for every locale `service-settings` ships.
- **Pins:** each of the three manifests carries the warning only as an `info_banner`, and no `description` or help string contains "⚠".

## Grade and order

- **p2.** It is admin-facing copy. No setting's key, value or save behaviour changes.
- It is independent of objectstack-ai/objectui#12610, which keeps items 1 and 4. The console's `info_banner` renderer draws the callout.

## Dedupe

The parent is objectstack-ai/objectui#12610.
